newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RTRS-Forward Corp refinances Waco unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Forward Corp refinances Waco unit.

text.p: South African firm Forward Corp Ltd said on Wednesday that its listed Australian scaffolding unit Waco Kwikform Ltd had successfully sealed a refinancing deal.

The agreement includes a 12 year sale and leaseback deal for A$50 million of the firm's equipment. This will reap A$6.0 million in cash immediately, the firm said, and so reduce Waco Kwikform's gearing to 22 percent from 32 percent.
Forward said the refinancing will strengthen Waco Kwikform's balance sheet and enhance its capacity to compete for new business.
In August the unit posted a 58 percent surge in year net profit to A$6.2 million, but said it wanted to cut its dependence on the weak construction industry.

Earlier on Wednesday in a separate statement Forward Corp said talks had ended on a possible sell-off of its 61 percent stake in McPhail Holdings Ltd, which has been hit by losses at its U.K. coal trading operation.
